title: Best student per department
statementMd:
For each course department find the student with the highest average score in that department's courses. Show department, student name and average rounded to 1 decimal. Break ties by name.

Expected columns: `department`, `name`, `avg_score`.

Tables: `teachers`, `courses`, `students`, `enrollments`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Aggregate by department and student, then `ROW_NUMBER`.
solutionMd:
```sql
WITH a AS (SELECT c.department, s.name, AVG(e.score) AS avg_score FROM enrollments e JOIN courses c ON c.id = e.course_id JOIN students s ON s.id = e.student_id GROUP BY c.department, s.id), r AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY department ORDER BY avg_score DESC, name) AS rn FROM a) SELECT department, name, ROUND(avg_score, 1) AS avg_score FROM r WHERE rn = 1;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
